title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Studio’s Biggest Blunder Gets a New Remake
content: Based on the 2019 manga by Coffee, the anime adaptation of Wandance debuted this year as a collaborative work between Madhouse and Cyclone Graphics. While Madhouse is one of the largest studios in the industry, Cyclone Graphics is still gaining a foothold by collaborating with the acclaimed studio on many projects,…
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 Will Be a Huge Disappointment For Fans
content: While the Jujutsu Kaisen manga reached its conclusion in September 2024, the anime still has a long way to go. The third season was confirmed as soon as JJK wrapped up its Shibuya Incident Arc. Season 2 has been a roller coaster of emotions with Gojo’s backstory and the most intense arc in the story so far.
author: ComicBook

title: Shonen Jump’s Best Magical Girl Series Confirms New Physical Release Ahead of Season 2
content: Kenta Shinohara’s Weekly Shonen Jump hit series Witch Watch is a refreshing fantasy series set in a modern world where mythological and fantasy creatures have evolved and learned to live among humans.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece Heroines Anime's Trailer Unveils Aina the End's Theme Song
content: The official website for the One Piece anime began streaming a trailer video for the anime for writer Jun Esaka and artist Sayaka Suwa 's One Piece Heroines light novel series on Tuesday. The trailer announces and previews the anime's theme song "Blue Shining Star" by singer Aina The End .
author: ANN

title: One Piece Heroines Anime Reveals New Trailer, Theme Song by AiNA THE END
content: A new trailer has been released for ONE PIECE HEROINES , the upcoming TV special based on ONE PIECE novel HEROINES . It was also announced that the theme song will be “Blue Shining Star,” a new track performed by AiNA THE END.
author: Anime Corner

title: 5 Upcoming Anime Live-Action Adaptations I Can’t Wait to See
content: Live-action anime adaptations have become a major trend, especially following the success of One Piece ‘s live-action adaptation. I remember seeing its success back in 2023, with many series following suit, and the success of Avatar: The Last Airbender’s live-action adaptation only further propelled the trend.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Liar Game' Unveils Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Promo for Second Cour
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shinobu Kaitani 's Liar Game manga announced additional cast, opening and ending themes, a promotional video, and key visual (pictured right) for the second cour on Monday. The second cour will begin airing at 12:00 a.m. on TV Tokyo, followed by BS TV Tokyo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sony's Annual USSEC Report Makes no Mention of Planned PC Releases
content: Sony 's annual report to the United States Securities and Exchange Commission this month has notably removed a line regarding its plans for PC releases for games, which was present in the 2025 version of the document.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Finally Debuts a High-Octane Action Comedy That Is Everything You’d Want From a 2026 Manga
content: 2026 has been a very productive year for Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazine, featuring the conclusion of many manga that had been running for a long time. This year has already seen the end of three major series, including Jujutsu Kaisen ‘s sequel, Modulo , Black Clover , and Chainsaw Man .
author: ComicBook

title: Game Producer Daisuke Satō Lists Himself as 'ex-Nagoshi Studio' on Social Media
content: The July 2/9 issue of the Weekly Famitsu magazine, which shipped on Thursday, also listed Satō as a game developer rather than a Nagoshi Studio producer in a special feature. The game studio's official website is unavailable as of press time on June 22.
author: ANN
